name: new-tab-container-picker
description: Choose a Firefox Multi-Account Container via a quick searchable popup whenever you open a new tab.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir=. --ignore-files=package.json package-lock.json node_modules tests README.md .gitignore web-ext-artifacts
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir=. --overwrite-dest --ignore-files=package.json package-lock.json node_modules tests README.md .gitignore web-ext-artifacts
scripts.start: web-ext run --source-dir=. --ignore-files=package.json package-lock.json node_modules tests README.md .gitignore web-ext-artifacts
